seo.title: GetUsRanked — Pricing
seo.description: Transparent, one-time pricing for web design and SEO. Choose between Starter, Growth, or Custom plans with SEO and AI-search visibility built in.

hero.heading: Simple pricing. Three ways to work with us.
hero.body: No hidden costs, no vague "contact for quote" on the plans that don't need it. Pick what fits, or reach out if your project doesn't fit a box.

items.label: PLAN 1
items.name: Starter
items.description: For businesses that need a real website live fast, with SEO done right from day one.
features: On-page SEO setup, optimized for up to 10 target keywords
AEO-ready FAQ schema (structured for AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity, not just Google)
Basic technical SEO foundation (site speed, indexing, meta structure)

items.label: PLAN 2
items.name: Growth
items.description: For businesses that need more site, more content structure, and a stronger SEO foundation to grow on.
features: WordPress or standard website, up to 10 pages
On-page SEO setup, optimized for up to 20 target keywords
AEO-ready FAQ schema across key pages
Blog/content system set up and ready to publish into
Deeper technical SEO (structured data, internal linking architecture, Core Web Vitals tuning)

items.label: PLAN 3
items.name: Custom
items.description: For businesses that need a full custom build, not a template, with room to grow and manage things yourself.
features: Custom website, WordPress or full-stack build, built to your exact requirements
On-page SEO setup, optimized for 40+ target keywords
An analytics/CRM dashboard so you can edit posts, publish new blog content, or manage core site content yourself, without touching code
items.payment: 50% upfront, 50% on delivery, milestone payments available for larger builds.
items.footnote: Need custom automation on top of this? (workflow automation, third-party integrations, booking/scheduling systems) — scoped and quoted separately, since every automation need is different.

afterLaunch.heading: After Launch
afterLaunch.body: All three plans are one-time builds. Once your site is live, an optional monthly SEO retainer keeps your rankings moving and adapts as search and AI-search algorithms change. This isn't bundled into the build price. It's offered after launch, when you've seen the work and can decide if you want to keep going.

items.q: Do you guarantee these keywords will rank?
items.a: No. We optimize your site to target and compete for the keyword count listed in each plan, honestly and with sustainable methods. No agency can guarantee a ranking position; anyone who promises that isn't being straight with you.

items.q: What if my project doesn't fit any of these three plans?
items.a: Reach out and we'll talk about it. Not every business fits neatly into 5, 10, or "custom" pages, and that's fine.
Ongoing content creation or link building after launch, paid ad management, and any custom feature not explicitly listed above. These are available separately.
Yes. Start with Starter or Growth and move up when you're ready. You're not locked into the tier you begin with.

bottomCta.heading: Ready to build a site that ranks?
bottomCta.body: Reach out today and let's discuss your project goals. No commitment, no pressure.
